thread:
taylor: quick proposal 10min: refresh retargeting + search mini-test next week. goals: reduce wasted impressions, keep CPL steady, and test a creative variant with webinar CTA. plan below.
rachel: sounds good. what segments are we using for retargeting?
diego: split by recency: 0-7d (high), 8-30d (mid), 31-90d (low). bid multipliers: +15% on high, +5% mid, -30% low. frequency cap 3 ads / 24h for high, 2 for mid.
priya: creative note 10s video + carousel for 0-7d, single image + testimonial quote for 8-30d. assets in Drive: https://drive.company/ads/retarget_refresh_1853. name files as rt_0-7_vid_v1.mp4, rt_8-30_img_v2.jpg etc.
taylor: search side: surgical negative keyword sweep (see list in Doc) and limit match types to phrase for broad terms. +20% on branded and product-intent keywords, -20% on generic non-converting terms.
rachel: tagging: use utm_campaign=retarget_refresh_1853, utm_source=ads, utm_exp=recency_split. Also include lead_source=paid_ret in form hidden field.
diego: routing: high-intent leads (form_score >= 80 OR used promo code RETARGET1853) -> HubSpot webhook -> SDR_inbox (priority). All others -> nurture sequence via Marketing Cloud. I'll add Zapier mapping.
priya: pacing: enable hourly dynamic pacing to keep daily spend within cap. sample rule I'll add: 
```
# throttle to avoid front-loading
if hour_spend > daily_budget * 0.15:
  reduce_bids(12%)
```

taylor: fallback/rollback thresholds: target CPL = $38, ramp if CPL improves >=12% vs control. rollback if CPL > $55 OR conversion rate drops >10% for 48h. min sample per variant = 300 clicks.
rachel: also add CPM and view-thru rate checks for video creative. pause video if view-thru < 20% after 48h.
diego: exclusion: exclude converters_90d + recent webinar signups (last 60d). code label: exclude_list=converters_90d, webinar60.
ads-bot: Draft campaigns created (paused): rt-refresh-1853-search, rt-refresh-1853-retarget-high, rt-refresh-1853-retarget-mid, rt-refresh-1853-retarget-low. Use `/ads launch rt-refresh-1853-search --start` to activate.
priya: matches with landing: we'll have a slight variant for retarget (show recent product updates + CTA) at /lp/retarget?promo=RT1853. no A/Bs during test.
taylor: frequency/pacing will be monitored in dashboard. @rachel can you post daily 9am snapshot (spend, CPL, CTR, view-thru, conv rate)?
rachel: yep will post.
diego: negative keywords I'll push to shared doc and update account-level list: generic terms, competitor X product names, and spammy queries.
priya: one more: please ensure impressions_by_user cap is enforced for cross-platform overlap (FB + Search) so people don't see both too often.
taylor: agreed. final timeline: creative freeze Fri EOD, QA Sat, launch Mon 8am PT. keep spend conservative first 48h.
rachel: noted. I'll also add experiment label retarget_refresh_1853 in GA and set event 'paid_ret_signup'.
diego: live monitoring on first day, Ill set alerts for CPL > 50 or spend spike > 30% hr-over-hr.
ads-bot: Alerts configured: CPL_alert=50, spend_spike_pct=30.
taylor: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup: everyone clear?
priya: clear
rachel: good to go
diego: ready
taylor: posting final checklist tonight.
